title: VerificationReport
$comment: The reviewed report FORMAT. Its deterministic serialization convention is RFC 8785 JCS (multi-producer convergence); the byte-level serialization vectors land with `verify` — same review discipline as the envelope. haltClass inlines the canonical halt-class union (local $defs).

assurance.description: the stated assurance level the report attests

claimedClass.description: the class the record was shaped for, as the caller stated it (TC-0..TC-4) — the walk's input, echoed so `verified` can be interpreted at all; required because a report carrying only the finding cannot say what the finding was measured against

supportedClass.description: the class the walk reached (TC-0..TC-4) — the highest whose every required step is proved, TC-0 if any step failed; a finding computed from the steps alone, neither capped nor lifted by `claimedClass`

asOf.description: the settlement's chain-anchored time every validity check is evaluated against (as-of-settlement-time)

coverage.description: supplied ports/bindings — coverage is part of honest depth

settlements.description: every settlement found for the fingerprint across the supplied forward-indexable bindings

multiplySettled.description: true when more than one settlement is found for the fingerprint
